oats and pepitas baked with cinnamon, then dried apricot and dark chocolateHow to make itNot on tonight's cookAlmonds, cashews, oats and pepitas roasted in honey and cinnamon, set into crunchy clusters with dried apricot and dark chocolate, one bag per sol.Mix 100g almonds, 100g cashews, 100g rolled oats and 50g pepitas.Warm 4 tbsp honey with 30g butter and half a tsp cinnamon, pour over and toss well.Press onto a lined tray and bake at 160°C for 20 minutes until golden.Cool completely, then break into clusters.Toss with 100g chopped dried apricots and 80g dark chocolate chunks and
